title: Print RFID
description: Print RFID labels and create RFID tags directly. Configure your printer, customize templates, and generate sequential tags.

form.title: RFID Configuration
form.description: Configure RFID type, category, and naming settings

quantity.label: Quantity
quantity.hint: Number of RFID tags to create

namingMode.label: Naming Mode
namingMode.systemHint: RFID names will be automatically generated (same as EPC)

store.label: Store
store.hint: Select a store to assign these RFIDs to, or leave as All Stores.

customPattern.label: Custom Pattern
customPattern.invalidFormat: Invalid pattern format. Use letters and numbers (e.g., AA001, 001BB)
customPattern.insufficientCapacity: Pattern cannot generate requested quantity. Increase padding or reduce quantity.

zpl.title: ZPL Label Configuration
zpl.description: Configure your label template using ZPL code

preview.title: Preview Settings
preview.noPreview: No preview available. Enter ZPL code and click Generate Preview.

code.label: ZPL Code
code.orManual: or enter ZPL code manually below
code.placeholder:
Enter your ZPL code here...

Example:
^XA
^FO50,50
^ADN,36,20
^FD{epc}^FS
^FO50,100
^ADN,24,12
^FD{name}^FS
^XZ
code.hint: Use {epc} or [epc] for the generated EPC code. Use {name} or [name] for the RFID name.
